ModuleTitle.helper: Administrator-facing title for this OpenContent module. This helps sync the content block with DNN module settings and is not displayed to visitors.

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Used to create a page anchor, such as business-category-list. Use letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

SectionTitle.helper: Optional. Main heading shown above the businesses.

SectionDescription.helper: Optional. Short introduction shown above the businesses. HTML is allowed.

SectionFooter.helper: Optional. Content shown below the businesses. HTML is allowed.
